name: Cathy Yan
bio: Cathy Yan is a filmmaker based in New York City, born in China and raised between Hong Kong and Washington, DC. She is known for Dead Pigs (2018) and DC Extended Universe Film Birds of Prey (2020).

credits.title: Sour Hearts
credits.overview: The movie unfolds from the perspective of a girl growing up in the outer boroughs of New York in the ’90s. With parents newly arrived from Shanghai, the family works through the unique trials of ascending to the middle class. credits.title: The Gallerist
credits.overview: Set against the glittering excess of Art Basel Miami, a desperate gallery owner conspires to pass off an accidental corpse as the centerpiece of her debut show.

credits.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
credits.overview: Harley Quinn joins forces with a singer, an assassin and a police detective to help a young girl who had a hit placed on her after she stole a rare diamond from a crime lord.

credits.title: Dead Pigs
credits.overview: A pig farmer, a busboy, a salon owner, an expat architect and a jaded rich girl cross paths as thousands of dead pigs float down the Yangtze River toward Shanghai.

credits.title: Sky Ladder: The Art of Cai Guo-Qiang
credits.overview: Known for his spectacular pyrotechnic displays, Chinese artist Cai Guo-Qiang creates his most ambitious project yet: Sky Ladder, a visionary, explosive event that he pulls off in his hometown in China after 20 years of failed attempts.

credits.title: According to My Mother
credits.overview: After the death of his beloved aunt, Daniel, a gay, struggling actor, visits Esther, his devout Christian, Korean mother. Despite their differences, they try to heal together. But old habits die hard.

credits.title: Down River
credits.overview: In an attempt to pay back his debtors, a pig farmer visits his successful son in Shanghai and discovers that he may have pinned his hopes on the wrong dream.

credits.title: The Stars The Sun The Moon
credits.overview: On a random night of summer 1998, two good friends from a boarding school travel through time to 15 years ahead by pure happenstance. credits.title: Groomed
credits.overview: When the groom goes missing on the day of their wedding, the bride must put her faith in his godmother's off-color scheme to replace him at the altar without anyone noticing.

credits.title: Last Night
credits.overview: The privileged son of a powerful Chinese politician endures a long night of revelry, humiliation and self-discovery as a public family scandal erupts around him.
